# Linked rules and interpretation guidance

Keep core rules and definitions concise and link them to sections in the same document or other standard documents that explain their patterns, anti-patterns, and both resolved and unresolved ambiguity. Allow the linked explanations to carry the depth needed to interpret and apply the rule, including as context for a model working with uncertainty.

Apply this as the authoring direction for the Execution and Operating Model standard. It does not accept answers to every open semantic question or establish that the resulting context improves model performance.
